description: This file defines bindings for I/O operations in a Lua C API context. It provides function declarations for printing Lua values, loading JSON, and reading files as text or string arrays.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints any Lua value to stdout, accepting multiple arguments.

methods.name: loadJSON
methods.description: Loads and parses JSON data from Lua.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file as a string.

methods.name: loadStrings
methods.description: Reads a file and returns an array of strings split by lines.
